title: Total Streak Duration
scenario: For each number, find the sum of all 'streak' lengths where streak length is > 1. Return 'num', 'total_streak_duration'.
hint: Sum the sizes of islands where island size > 1.
correctQuery: SELECT num, SUM(streak) AS total_streak_duration FROM (SELECT num, COUNT(*) AS streak FROM (SELECT id, num, id - ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY num ORDER BY id)::INT AS grp FROM logs) t GROUP BY num, grp HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t2 GROUP BY num;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE logs (id INT, num VARCHAR); INSERT INTO logs VALUES (1, '1'), (2, '1'), (4, '1'), (5, '1');
